title: QOL Overhaul
description: A lightweight Quality of Life modpack that improves performance, usability, and convenience while keeping Minecraft's vanilla feel intact.
body:
QOL Overhaul:
QoL Overhaul is a carefully curated Quality of Life modpack that enhances Minecraft while staying true to the vanilla experience. Instead of adding overwhelming amounts of content, this pack focuses on improving the parts of the game you interact with every day.
From better inventory management and improved user interfaces to useful visual upgrades and performance optimizations, every mod has been selected to make Minecraft feel smoother, cleaner, and more enjoyable. Whether you're building massive projects, exploring distant biomes, surviving your first night, or managing complex storage systems, QoL Overhaul helps reduce frustration and improve convenience.
Features
✔ Performance improvements for smoother gameplay
✔ Better menus, tooltips, and interface enhancements
✔ Inventory and storage management utilities
✔ Exploration and navigation improvements
✔ Visual upgrades that preserve the vanilla style
✔ Useful gameplay tweaks and accessibility features
✔ Multiplayer-friendly design
✔ Lightweight and easy to run
Perfect For
Vanilla+ players
Builders and creators
Survival enthusiasts
Casual players
Multiplayer servers
Low-end and mid-range devices
QoL Overhaul aims to make Minecraft feel like the game you already love—just more polished, efficient, and enjoyable. No unnecessary complexity, no giant progression systems, and no overwhelming content dumps. Just a better Minecraft experience from the moment you create a new world.
Enhance. Simplify. Enjoy. 🚀
